comment: A running CodeSpace session's transcript survives a host restart: the Connection Owner mirrors each running session's events.jsonl (whole lines, by byte offset, only while a session provably runs) and pushes it into the agent-logger hub under its own .codespaces-live/<name> label (never over the close-out capture's .codespaces/<name>), and agent-logger's session-fetch finds sessions under both, preferring the complete close-out copy. AGENT_CODESPACES_TRANSCRIPT_MIRROR=0 turns the mirror off.
